name: Conservation Partner Grants
summary: Annual small grants to nonprofit and governmental partners that protect grizzly bear habitat, including private land conservation, and prevent conflicts between bears and people, such as retiring conflict-prone grazing leases.

deadline.text: Applications will be accepted until March 15, 2026
